title: Skin Care for Chandigarh Weather: A Routine for Dry Summers, Haze and Cold Winters
ex: Hot dry summers, a humid monsoon, hazy autumn weeks and cold, foggy winters: a simple skin care routine for people living in Chandigarh, season by season.
rt: Skin Care for Chandigarh Weather: Season Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Chandigarh weather: sun in dry summers, light monsoon care, haze in November, heaters and dry skin in foggy winters, all kept simple.
quick: Chandigarh has hot, dry summers, a humid monsoon, hazy autumn weeks and cold, foggy winters, so your routine should change with the season. A gentle face wash, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning, light textures from April to September and richer moisturising from November to February suit most people.
facts: Chandigarh sits at the foot of the Shivalik hills
April to June is hot, dry and sunny
The monsoon runs roughly July to September
December and January are cold and often foggy
